# jasonjames.works

> The design portfolio of Jason James, a UX designer. The site is currently a single-page "Coming Soon" placeholder while the full portfolio is built.

Details:

- Author: Jason James — UX/product designer; work has included Openbank's US launch, Safrapay's chatbot, and design-system and accessibility practice at Banco Santander.
- Status: pre-launch. `https://jasonjames.works/` serves one page: an animated "Coming Soon" title, a header, and a footer. There is no portfolio, case-study, or résumé content on the site yet.
- Stack: hand-written static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. No framework, no build step, no analytics.
- Hosting: source on GitHub, deployed via Netlify. Domain registered with GoDaddy.
- Licensing: code is open under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Confidential client work lives in a separate private repository and requires a credential to access; it is not part of this site.
- Typography: `Bungee` (David Jonathan Ross) for headings, `Lexend` for body text. Icons from Font Awesome.

## Site

- [Home](https://jasonjames.works/): The only published page. "Coming Soon" placeholder.

## Elsewhere

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasonjamesworks/): Professional profile — the most current summary of Jason's work history.
